t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Click on the right hand side to gain more mushrooms and try not to miss any rounds. Although 20 rounds isn't enough to guarantee that this would happen through practice, it tends to work for the majority.

vb_textbox.text: Position your fingers on the keys 's' and 'k' to select the gnomes and ensure you press the key in time otherwise you will miss out on points for that round.I noticed that no matter what colour the gnomes were (I didn't pay attention to this after a while), I tended to get more points when I selected the righthand side and pressed the 'k' key. I sometimes forgot to press 'space' on time so I put my finger on 'k' and the other on 'space' instead of 's' and selected the righthand side for nearly all of the second round.Good luck!
